**1.027: Send instead of Stop, one tap to change mic, and no more clashing takes.**

- **Keyboard and floating mic:** only one can record at a time now. Starting a take in one drops a take open in the other, so the new one records. Auto-start in the keyboard waits if the floating mic is already recording. Not yet tested on a phone.
- **Send:** during a take the mic is a green send arrow, on the floating mic and the keyboard. Stop read as stopping, not as sending to be transcribed.
- **Colours:** on the floating mic and the keyboard, Retake is orange and Pause is blue, turning gold while paused.
- **Changing mic:** one tap on the mic name moves straight to the next connected mic in your order. The row of mic icons is gone.
- arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
